info.name: Just Eat UK Attempted Delivery API DeliveryFee API

params.name: restaurantIds
params.description: Restaurant IDs which fees are requested for. e.g. `?restaurantIds=1,2,3,4`

params.name: deliveryTime
params.description: Delivery date/time when fees are required (ISO8601 format).

params.name: zone
params.description: Postcode or other location name identifying the location to which delivery is required. For use when precise location is not available. This will be removed in future in favour of location.

params.name: latlong
params.description: Point to which delivery is required (latitude, longitude). Supply this where possible as support for zone-only based lookups will be removed in future.

items.docs: Retrieve delivery fees for many restaurants. Returns fees and minimum order values required for delivery orders.
